source: PLAN.md §7 storyboard, reshaped for StillHere Pilot. Claim text is quoted word for word from PREREG.md ("prereg", with D18's replacement for §7's first line) or PLAN.md §1 ("plan"), or comes from demo/lines.json and the Spark desk's licensed lines; numbers are filled from results/*.json and stillhere/validation_table.json at render time. The sedation case study carries only frozen group statistics. "caption" items are neutral labels. tests/test_video.py checks all of it.

items.text: Passive listening tests can show that a brain still processes speech without asking the patient to do anything, which marks patients worth a full follow-up scan.
Research tool for brain-imaging labs, built on Meta's TRIBE v2. Healthy volunteers, public data. Not a diagnosis or medical advice.
Families and doctors decide on life support for unresponsive patients, and about 40% of these patients are misdiagnosed
About 1 in 4 people who seem unresponsive after brain injury can covertly follow commands in their head
items.note: Bodien, NEJM 2024; that figure comes from command-following tests, not passive listening

items.text: Passive listening tests can show that a brain still processes speech without asking the patient to do anything, which marks patients worth a full follow-up scan.
But every new story needs its own 12-15 healthy volunteers scanned on it, in that language.
StillHere needs none: Meta's TRIBE v2 stands in for them, and every reading is measured against the person's own resting brain.

scenes.title: Two gauges, each in units of the person's own rest scan

items.text: auditory cortex follows TRIBE's audio-only prediction
language cortex follows what TRIBE's language pathway adds on top of the audio and the word rate
Both gauges are expressed in units of the person's own rest scan ("times above your own rest scan"), so no control group enters the scoring.
